name: Papua New Guinea
officialName: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

flag.description: Divided diagonally from upper hoist to lower fly: the upper fly triangle is red with a yellow bird-of-paradise, and the lower hoist triangle is black with the five white stars of the Southern Cross.
flag.symbolism: Red and black are traditional colours in Papua New Guinean art; the bird-of-paradise symbolises the nation's emergence and the Southern Cross its place in the southern hemisphere.

hook: Split diagonally: a golden bird-of-paradise flies in the red half while the Southern Cross shines in the black half.
trivia: The flag was designed by Susan Karike, a 15-year-old schoolgirl, and chosen in 1971.
Papua New Guinea has over 800 living languages, more than any other country.
